proofs.text: Run the status report over a project with 2 rules of which 1 meets the gate `passed`; verify the summary reads `1 of 2 rules meet the gate passed.` and that the line under it names no test strength and no risk threshold

rule_text: The status report's summary line reads `<met> of <rules> rules meet the gate <gate>`, and the line under it names a test strength, a risk threshold or a signature count only at the gate that asks for one

tests.body:
def test_the_summary_counts_the_rules_that_meet_the_gate(self, project):
        project.proofs([_entry('PROOF-2', 'RULE-2')])
        text = purlin_status.sync_status(project.root)
        line = next(line for line in text.splitlines()
                    if 'meet the gate' in line)
        assert line == '1 of 2 rules meet the gate passed.', line
        second = text.splitlines()[text.splitlines().index(line) + 1]
        assert 'test strength' not in second, second
        assert 'risk' not in second, second
tests.name: test_the_summary_counts_the_rules_that_meet_the_gate
